items.statement: Community clinic and outpatient critical values verified after 17:00 are notified within 30 minutes much less often than inpatient values (below 70 against above 90 percent).
items.rationale: Consistent with the retrieved call-log studies; directly informs the escalation decision; data already exist.
items.risks: Missing read-back times could exaggerate delays.

items.statement: Delay beyond 30 minutes is more likely when a single technologist covers bench work and notification at night, independently of location.
items.rationale: Supported by one network study (claim c4); needs roster data.

items.statement: Most delays beyond one hour involve three or more call attempts.
items.rationale: Call attempts are logged; identifies where escalation would act.
items.risks: Attempts are a mediator, not a cause.

summary: Three hypotheses; h1 selected, h2 and h3 as pre-specified secondary questions.
